request.raw_text: Design simple locking mechanism in the area of the hook to secure carried load.

areas_to_change.action: Add a simple locking or retaining feature
areas_to_change.reference_geometry: The open hook at the narrow end of the tapered arm
areas_to_change.location: Across or immediately adjacent to the hook opening, using the hook tip and neck as potential support locations
areas_to_change.description: Create a gate, latch, or equivalent retainer that closes the open mouth of the hook while retaining the existing load-bearing hook pocket. Provide local attachment or engagement geometry as needed for the locking feature.

areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve its overall length, taper, thickness, and load path except for minimal local changes needed to support the hook lock.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Forked clevis end and transverse through-hole
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the fork spacing, rounded outer profile, hole size, hole alignment, and mounting function.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Hook bowl and load-bearing inner curved surface
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the usable load-supporting pocket and avoid materially reducing its section or capacity.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Existing overall part orientation and envelope
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Keep the main arm and both end interfaces in their current relative positions.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: The narrow-end hook will include a compact closure feature spanning or obstructing its open mouth, likely a pivoting gate, snap latch, sliding retainer, or integral flexible tab with a mating catch.
predicted_final_outcome.function: The added mechanism will prevent a carried item from unintentionally escaping through the hook opening while maintaining the hook's load-carrying role.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: The closure will remain engaged during carrying, open or release deliberately for loading and unloading, and return to or be secured in the closed position.

ambiguities.description: The requested locking-mechanism type and operating method are not specified.
candidate_interpretations: Pivoting gate with a spring or detent

ambiguities.description: The request does not state whether the lock must close automatically or require manual engagement.
Required load rating, allowable opening size, material, clearances, and manufacturing method are unspecified.
candidate_interpretations: Machined lock with a separate pin
Higher-load metal gate with a positive catch
